prompt_rules: Do not open, read, grep, or list anything under `benchmarks/mission-vs-goal/` except the fixture files named in this prompt and your own output file. Benchmark metadata (task definitions, scoring configuration, answer keys) is out of bounds.
For every confirmed finding, quote the exact identifier or value from the fixture as evidence.
Explicitly separate confirmed findings from rejected candidates when the task involves candidates to reject.

tasks.prompt: Read exactly this fixture: `benchmarks/mission-vs-goal/fixtures/portfolio/settings-registry.md`. Check every referenced constant and report each reference that points at a constant not present in the registry, quoting the exact name.
tasks.validator: Artifact must list every dangling constant reference with the exact quoted name.
tasks.hypothesis: Minutes-scale Simple task (120-constant cross-check); the mission arm should route to the goal contract. To test, not assert.
